title: Harmony in Diversity: Multi-domain Contrastive Policy Optimization for Large Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.25443v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-domain capabilities are critical for practically applicable Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). Therefore, mixed-domain Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a crucial process to jointly train a single LRM with mixed domain data, but it often induces capability trade-offs among different domains. Existing methods attribute this issue to competing cross-domain interactions, and mitigate them by isolating learning directions and balancing learning progress. However, our observation suggests that they also impede supportive knowledge sharing across domains, which make it difficult to match or surpass single-domain performance. translated_title: 多样性中的和谐：面向大型推理模型的多域对比策略优化
translated_abstract: 多领域能力对于实际可用的大型推理模型（LRMs）至关重要。因此，混合领域强化学习（RL）已成为利用混合领域数据联合训练单个大型推理模型的关键过程，但它往往会在不同领域之间引发能力此消彼长的权衡问题。现有方法将这一问题归因于跨领域之间的竞争性交互，并通过隔离学习方向和平衡学习进度来加以缓解。然而，我们的观察表明，这些方法同时也阻碍了跨领域之间的有益知识共享，导致多领域训练难以达到甚至超越单领域训练的性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了多域对比策略优化（MCPO），它应用对比学习来实现多样化的知识共享与竞争。我们首先将交互单元定位于关键推理片段上，然后构建相互……
tldr: 提出多域对比策略优化（MCPO）方法，通过在关键推理片段上应用对比学习，实现跨领域的知识共享与竞争的平衡，从而缓解混合领域强化学习中不同领域间的能力权衡问题，使单个大型推理模型的多领域性能得以匹配甚至超越单领域训练。
en_tdlr: Proposes Multi-domain Contrastive Policy Optimization (MCPO), which applies contrastive learning localized on critical reasoning segments to achieve both supportive knowledge sharing and necessary competition across domains, mitigating capability trade-offs in mixed-domain RL and enabling LRMs to match or surpass single-domain performance.
